description: This is a shell script used as a test runner for a software project. It applies patches idempotently, manages specific revisions of a dependency (ThunderTools), builds the project using CMake, and runs tests with CTest. It is designed for automation in CI/CD pipelines to ensure the environment is correctly prepared before testing.

methods.name: apply_patch_idempotent
methods.description: Applies a patch to a target directory in an idempotent, non-interactive manner, handling cases where the patch is already applied or would fail to apply cleanly.

methods.name: ensure_thundertools_expected_revision
methods.description: Resets the ThunderTools directory to a specific git revision/tag, ensuring a known baseline before patching.

methods.name: run_build_and_l1_tests
methods.description: Configures, builds, and runs the project's unit tests using CMake and CTest, with options to skip dependency installation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates patch application, revision pinning, building, and testing workflow.
